overview: Former detective Nick Charles has retired from police work, preferring a life of cocktails, parties, and relaxation with his wealthy wife, Nora. Their holiday is interrupted when the daughter of Nick’s former client asks for help finding her missing father, eccentric inventor Clyde Wynant. When Wynant’s body is discovered, Nick is drawn back into the investigation, with Nora eagerly joining him. As the couple questions Wynant’s family, friends, and business associates, a tangled web of greed, deception, and murder begins to unravel. Directed by W. S. Van Dyke and adapted from Dashiell Hammett’s novel, The Thin Man combines witty dialogue, sophisticated comedy, romance, and classic mystery. William Powell and Myrna Loy are perfectly matched as Nick and Nora Charles, whose playful banter and effortless chemistry made them one of Hollywood’s most beloved screen couples. This stylish 1934 mystery remains a landmark of classic American cinema.

title: Chef
actors: Saif Ali Khan, Svar Kamble, Padmapriya Janakiraman
overview: Roshan Kalra is a three-star Michelin chef who gets fired from New York's Gulli restaurant after he punches a customer. Forced to take a break, he flies to Kochi to spend time with his son, Armaan and his estranged wife Radha Menon. It's a fruitful trip because he manages to mend broken family ties. In a bid to help him get his mojo back, his wife suggests he put up his own food truck and begin afresh.

title: Haramkhor
actors: Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Shweta Tripathi, Trimala Adhikari
overview: A small-town schoolteacher enters an inappropriate relationship with his student in rural Gujarat.

title: Anaarkali of Aarah
actors: Swara Bhaskar, Sanjay Mishra, Pankaj Tripathi
overview: Hailing from Aarah in Bihar, Anarkali is an item girl, famous for her vocals, suggestive dance moves and innuendo laden lyrics. She enjoys her stardom and revels in the lusty glances. The singer acknowledges that she is no saint and even makes peace with the hatred she evokes among civilised society but what she refuses to tolerate is being exploited in public by an influential politician.

title: Gold
actors: Akshay Kumar, Mouni Roy, Kunal Kapoor, Sunny Kaushal
overview: Set in 1948, the historic story of India's first Olympic medal post their independence.

title: Satyameva Jayate
actors: John Abraham, Manoj Bajpayee, Aisha Sharma
overview: DCP Shivansh has been tasked to catch Vir, the man behind police killings in the city. Both are eventually against the same enemy but divided by a fine line, the law.

title: Raid
actors: Ajay Devgn, Saurabh Shukla, Ileana D'Cruz
overview: After receiving an anonymous tip, a tax officer leads a raid on the mansion of the most powerful figure in Lucknow, a member of parliament who has been evading income tax for years.

title: Hichki
actors: Rani Mukerji, Neeraj Kabi, Rohit Saraf
overview: After finally landing a teaching job, a kindhearted woman with Tourette Syndrome faces a flawed system to provide an education to her forgotten students.

title: October
actors: Varun Dhawan, Banita Sandhu, Gitanjali Rao
overview: Dan, a 21-year-old carefree boy is always surrounded by a bunch of friends and fellow hotel interns who feed off each other's everyday moments, their ups and downs. Shiuli is also an intern working in the same hotel, who at times is at a receiving end of Dan's audaciousness. Everything was normal in their life until a sudden turn of events smashes Dan and Shiuli's lives together, into a bond.

title: Veere Di Wedding
actors: Kareena Kapoor Khan, Sonam Kapoor, Swara Bhaskar, Shikha Talsania
overview: Kalindi, Avni, Sakshi and Meera are childhood friends. Kalindi and Rishabh are getting married, and the four gal pals come together for their veere’s wedding. But of course, there can be no shaadi without showsha and a lot of drama. This wedding celebration brings out skeletons from the closet, unspoken truths and some harsh realities as well.

title: Sui Dhaaga: Made in India
actors: Varun Dhawan, Anushka Sharma, Raghubir Yadav
overview: A heartwarming story of pride and self-reliance capturing the journey of Mauji and his wife Mamta, who pursue their passion by overcoming all odds.

title: Kedarnath
actors: Sushant Singh Rajput, Sara Ali Khan, Nitish Bharadwaj
overview: Mansoor, a reserved and reticent Pithoo (porter), helps pilgrims make an arduous journey upwards to the temple town. His world turns around when he meets the beautiful and rebellious Mukku who draws him into a whirlwind of intense love.

title: Parmanu: The Story of Pokhran
actors: John Abraham, Diana Penty, Boman Irani
overview: A look at India's second confidential nuclear test series at Pokhran lead by Dr. APJ Abdul Kalam, during the time of PM Atal Bihari Vajpayee's tenure.

title: Zero
actors: Shah Rukh Khan, Anushka Sharma, Katrina Kaif
overview: Short in stature but big on love, a bachelor meets two very different women who broaden his horizons and help him find purpose in life.

title: Baaghi 2
actors: Tiger Shroff, Disha Patani, Manoj Bajpayee, Randeep Hooda
overview: Ronny, a battle-hardened soldier, learns of the disappearance of the daughter of his former lover. His intense investigation leads him to uncover a web of crimes and a secret from the past.

title: Lust Stories
directors: Anurag Kashyap, Zoya Akhtar, Dibakar Banerjee, Karan Johar
actors: Radhika Apte, Bhumi Pednekar, Manisha Koirala, Kiara Advani, Vicky Kaushal
overview: An anthology of four stories that sheds light on modern relationships from the viewpoint of the Indian woman.

title: Manto
actors: Nawazuddin Siddiqui, Rasika Dugal, Tahir Raj Bhasin, Rishi Kapoor
overview: In Bombay's seedy-shiny film world, Manto and his stories are widely read and accepted. But as sectarian violence engulfs the nation, Manto makes the difficult choice of leaving his beloved Bombay. In Lahore, he finds himself bereft of friends and unable to find takers for his writings.

title: Pad Man
actors: Akshay Kumar, Radhika Apte, Sonam Kapoor
overview: Upon realizing the extent to which women are affected by their menses, a man sets out to create a sanitary pad machine and to provide inexpensive sanitary pads to the women of rural India.

title: Karwaan
actors: Irrfan Khan, Dulquer Salmaan, Mithila Palkar
overview: Avinash, a dejected soul stuck in a dead-end job shares a strange relationship with his father. He holds him responsible for crushing his dreams. However, he is left pondering upon this longstanding hatred when he hears of his father’s untimely demise.

title: Bhavesh Joshi Superhero
actors: Harsh Varrdhan Kapoor, Priyanshu Painyuli, Nishikant Kamat
overview: A young man who stands for the right discovers that he's destined to do bigger things, which will transform him from a common man into a Superhero.

title: Kaalakaandi
actors: Saif Ali Khan, Isha Talwar, Shenaz Treasury, Vijay Raaz
overview: Unfolding through a course of a night in Mumbai, Kaalakaandi showcases three parallel tracks — a man who discovers he has terminal illness decides to let go of his principles and live a little; a woman involved in a hit-and-run seeks redemption and two goons must decide if they can trust each other.

title: 102 Not Out
actors: Amitabh Bachchan, Rishi Kapoor, Jimit Trivedi
overview: An unusual love-hate relationship between a 75-year-old son and his 102-year-old father, who wants to break the oldest-man-alive record.

title: Bioscopewala
actors: Danny Denzongpa, Geetanjali Thapa, Adil Hussain
overview: Based on Rabindranath Tagore’s famous short story 'Kabuliwala', the film is about a young girl’s quest to discover more about her dead father’s friend who used to play bioscope shows for her as a kid.

title: Soorma
actors: Diljit Dosanjh, Taapsee Pannu, Angad Bedi
overview: Soorma, a comeback story of the hockey legend Sandeep Singh is a biopic that chronicles the life and times of the famed hockey player.

title: Section 375
actors: Akshaye Khanna, Richa Chadha, Meera Chopra, Rahul Bhat
overview: A filmmaker stands trial when a costume assistant on his movie accuses him of rape.

title: Dream Girl
actors: Ayushmann Khurrana, Nushrratt Bharuccha, Annu Kapoor
overview: Desperate to find employment, Karam picks up a job as ‘Pooja’ at a call center for sex chats, keeping most people in his life in the dark about the nature of his work. How long can he keep it up before everyone including his girlfriend and father find out?

title: Bala
actors: Ayushmann Khurrana, Bhumi Pednekar, Yami Gautam
overview: A man suffering from alopecia copes with his lack of self-confidence and the societal pressure that comes with being bald.

title: Kesari
actors: Akshay Kumar, Parineeti Chopra, Mir Sarwar
overview: In 1897, an army of 21 Sikhs battles 10,000 Afghans to prevent the Saragarhi Fort from being taken down.

title: Batla House
actors: John Abraham, Mrunal Thakur, Ravi Kishan
overview: Following a gunfight with suspects believed to be innocent by the media and public, an honest cop struggles to justify police actions before beginning the hunt for fugitives.

title: Luka Chuppi
actors: Kartik Aaryan, Kriti Sanon, Pankaj Tripathi
overview: The story of a television reporter in Mathura who falls in love with a headstrong woman.

title: Badla
actors: Amitabh Bachchan, Taapsee Pannu, Amrita Singh, Tony Luke
overview: A dynamic young entrepreneur finds herself locked in a hotel room with the corpse of her dead lover. She hires a prestigious lawyer to defend her and they work together to figure out what actually happened.

title: Pati Patni Aur Woh
actors: Kartik Aaryan, Bhumi Pednekar, Ananya Panday
overview: Chintu Tyagi is an ordinary, middle-class man who finds himself torn between his wife and another woman.

title: Sonchiriya
actors: Sushant Singh Rajput, Bhumi Pednekar, Manoj Bajpayee, Ranvir Shorey
overview: A legion of warring bandits terrorizes India's Chambal Valley.

title: Mard Ko Dard Nahi Hota
actors: Abhimanyu Dassani, Radhika Madan, Gulshan Devaiah
overview: Leveraging his ability to withstand pain, a young man trains to follow in the footsteps of his martial arts hero.

title: The Sky Is Pink
actors: Priyanka Chopra Jonas, Farhan Akhtar, Zaira Wasim, Rohit Saraf
overview: After succumbing to her terminal illness, a teenager posthumously narrates her parents’ tenacious relationship.

title: Mardaani 2
actors: Rani Mukerji, Vishal Jethwa, Vikram Singh Chauhan
overview: Officer Shivani Shivaji Roy is stationed at Kota where she goes against a ferocious serial killer who rapes and murders women.

title: Marjaavaan
actors: Sidharth Malhotra, Riteish Deshmukh, Tara Sutaria, Rakul Preet Singh
overview: Raghu and Zoya are enjoying their lives together until a gang leader with harmful intentions turns their world upside down.

title: Commando 3
actors: Vidyut Jammwal, Adah Sharma, Angira Dhar, Gulshan Devaiah
overview: A mysterious man is on an impending mission to attack the country from his base in London. Karan Singh Dogra sets out to hunt down the antagonist aided by the British Intelligence.

title: Panipat
actors: Arjun Kapoor, Sanjay Dutt, Kriti Sanon, Mohnish Bahl
overview: During 18th century India, the Marathas emerged as the most powerful empire in the nation until the Afghan King Ahmad Shah Abdali plans to take over India. Sadashiv Rao Bhau is brought in to save the empire from the king which then leads to the third battle of Panipat.

title: Bharat
actors: Salman Khan, Katrina Kaif, Sunil Grover, Disha Patani
overview: At the cusp of India's birth as an Independent nation, a family makes an arduous journey to freedom at a cost. A young boy Bharat, makes a promise to his Father that he will keep his family together no matter what.

title: De De Pyaar De
actors: Ajay Devgn, Tabu, Rakul Preet Singh, Jimmy Shergill
overview: A 50-year-old single father faces disapproval from his family and his ex-wife when he falls in love with a 26-year-old woman.

title: Manikarnika: The Queen of Jhansi
actors: Kangana Ranaut, Jisshu Sengupta, Atul Kulkarni
overview: Story of Rani Lakshmibai, one of the leading figures of the Indian Rebellion of 1857 and her resistance to the British Rule.

title: The Tashkent Files
actors: Shweta Basu Prasad, Naseeruddin Shah, Mithun Chakraborty
overview: The Tashkent Files is a thriller that revolves around the mysterious death of India's 2nd Prime Minister Shri Lal Bahadur Shastri and attempts to uncover if he had actually died a natural death, or, as alleged, was assassinated.

title: Judgementall Hai Kya
actors: Kangana Ranaut, Rajkummar Rao, Jimmy Shergill
overview: When Bobby meets her new tenants, a young married couple, their perfectly normal life leaves her really curious. But then a murder takes place and Bobby suspects Keshav has a role to play in the crime.

title: Mission Mangal
actors: Akshay Kumar, Vidya Balan, Taapsee Pannu, Nithya Menen, Kirti Kulhari, Sharman Joshi
overview: A team of Indian scientists at ISRO (Indian Space Research Organisation) take on the extraordinary task of successfully sending a satellite into the orbit of planet Mars in a country's maiden attempt.
